meta.title: FCC News Bulletin — Master Source Catalog
meta.scope: Editorial + official sources ONLY. NO social media (X/Facebook/Reddit/YouTube/LinkedIn/etc.) per contract.
meta.note: Fields marked 'verify' are unconfirmed URLs, NOT fabricated. Long tail to 2000+ is built by ingesting the datasets in 'scale_path'.
